notes: simple2 previously failed its first scene submission with a terminal BACKEND_FAILURE and never rendered a frame. It now completes 600 frames with zero dispatch failures.
The simple2 measurement is display-paced at 120 Hz, so 120.005 FPS describes the ProMotion presentation cadence and not renderer headroom. It establishes admission, not a performance result.
CityWorld is the regression control: it reaches the populated path on frame one and is unaffected by the deferral. It still renders clean.

CityWorld measured 30.74 ms here against a 39.41 ms recorded baseline. That is not claimed as an improvement: run-to-run spread on this machine was already measured at roughly 3x, so a single run distinguishes nothing.
Every roadmap visual gate is declared against simple2-based validation scenes, so this unblocks measuring V0/V1/V2 milestones on Ogre-Next.
summary: The pinned simple2 validation terrain renders on the Ogre-Next path for the first time.
